title: Pair Flip
tagline: Find every pair in the fewest moves
description: Flip two cards at a time, remember what you saw, and match every pair on the board. Twelve drawn symbols, each in its own strong colour, across three board sizes from a gentle four by three up to a twenty-four card test of nerve. Your fewest moves and fastest time are kept on this device for every size.
instructions: Tap the board or press Space to start, and choose a board size with the left and right arrow keys or by tapping one of the three chips.
Flip two cards at a time: tap them, or move the focus ring with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space.
A matching pair stays face up and glows, while a mismatch shakes and flips back after a moment you can always tap straight through.
Clear every pair to finish. Press M for sound and P to pause; your fewest moves and best time are saved for each board size.
